question: Which of the following numbers can possibly be a perfect square?
solution:
**Formula Used:**

A number is a perfect square if its square root is an integer.

**Calculation:**

⇒ √245982 ≈ 495.95 (not an integer)

⇒ √496838 ≈ 704.87 (not an integer)

⇒ √178343 ≈ 422.35 (not an integer)

⇒ √571536 = 756 (an integer)

**∴ The correct answer is 571536.**
